primary_result: The complete 542-group strict-unmatched Haze4K query census produced 41 forward-prequalified candidates and 39 unique bidirectionally verified new OTS source mappings, below the frozen exact requirement of 42. The route therefore ended COMPLETED_GATE_FAIL and does not authorize OTS outdoor measurement design, training, inference, or evaluation.
gate_reasons: Dataset hashes and frozen counts matched; all 1,000 canonical Haze4K source groups, 8,970 OTS clear scenes, 50 SOTS-indoor negative controls, and 492 SOTS-outdoor overlap controls completed.
The 458 strict Haze4K-OTS mappings, 542 strict-unmatched groups, 492 SOTS-outdoor exclusions, and parent 920-scene exclusion union reproduced exactly.
All 458 known OTS positive controls were recovered in both top-64 and top-one, and none of the 50 SOTS-indoor negative controls was admitted.
The new-mapping completeness, uniqueness, and mutual-nearest gates failed because only 39 unique bidirectionally verified mappings were available instead of exactly 42.
The provisional 959-scene exclusion union would leave 8,011 OTS scenes and passes the 6,000-scene capacity gate, but it is not an authorized exclusion asset because the mapping gate failed.
The typed closeout authorizes NONE; the 39 mappings cannot be used to silently relax the preregistered source-independence requirement.
competing_explanation: The three missing provenance-expected OTS sources may differ from this OTS copy through transformations not represented by the frozen seven-view global matcher, or the published provenance count may not map one-to-one to the local scene identities. This scientific FAIL establishes only that the frozen full-query matcher did not close all 42 mappings; it is not an infeasibility certificate.
limitations: This route qualifies source identity only and does not define or validate an outdoor local measurement field.
The 39 verified mappings and 959-scene provisional union remain diagnostic because the exact-42 gate failed.
A next source-identity route requires a permitted new evidence type such as an official source manifest or independent geometric mapping; threshold tuning or another adjacent run is not authorized.
Haze4K and SOTS GT images were used only for source identity, not model evaluation, and no training, inference, checkpoint selection, confirmation outcome, canary, or locked-test metric was accessed.
